turns.text: What are the milestones in PHR creation

must_contain: Building a PHR application is four ABDM milestones in order: P1, P2, P3 and P4
P1 is registration and login, P2 finds and links records, P3 covers subscriptions, consent and fetching records, and P4 is a health locker that keeps records for the long term
notes: NHA PHR review, 30 September 2026, case 3: the panel said 'three milestones' and left P4 out, because the milestones page's own description said 'the three PHR milestones' and the PHR entry named none. Source lines: catalogue/shared/glossary/phr.md, 'Building one is four ABDM milestones, in order: P1 ... P2 ... P3 ... P4'. Routed to the overview shape.
